rosary-shaped-chambered-burrow-hormosiro.note: All eight individual final images opened. Hero, reverse hero and top show an unbranched sinuous sequence of 13 rounded chambers with narrow continuous necks. Front/rear reveal true low relief and side projects the chain compactly as expected. Clay shows actual rounded relief, no painted-only rings or floating separate pearls. Solid slab silhouette intentionally does not reveal low internal relief. Schematic trace morphology, not a producer or exact specimen replica.

zoophycos-spiral-spreite.note: All eight individual final images opened. Broad helicoidal spreite with curved radial lamellar relief surrounds a modest axial cylinder. Reverse hero clearly shows terminal cut faces and overlapped 1.25-turn sheet; front, side and rear show true separation and rise, not a stack of flat disconnected disks. Clay confirms curved sculptural lamellae. Slab silhouette is a support outline and cannot alone establish the internal helicoid. This is an interpretive exposed trace reconstruction, not a living organism or an unaltered fossil.

lumbricaria-thread-like-coprolite.note: All eight individual final images opened. Hero, reverse hero and top show thin irregular looping cords and locally joined compressed crossings, not a uniform spring, worm body or a mound. Orthographic edges show genuine low relief on a solid slab; clay confirms geometry rather than only dark coloration. Broad support silhouette intentionally conceals low internal relief. Producer identity and exact crossing chronology remain uncertain, original loop design is not a specimen scan.
